# Flexoki Warm

Flexoki Warm is a warm variant of Flexoki that restores the default light-mode backgrounds of Obsidian while tinting the sidebar and context menus with a subtle warm hue. The recorded description also allows a Flexoki palette accent to be chosen as an override for the accent color.

![Flexoki Warm screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ofalvai/flexoki-warm/HEAD/screenshots/cover-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Flexoki Warm"
    author: "ofalvai"
    repo:   "ofalvai/flexoki-warm"
    slug:   "flexoki-warm"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/flexoki-warm"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/ofalvai/flexoki-warm"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ofalvai/flexoki-warm/HEAD/screenshots/cover-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a warm variant of the Flexoki theme that restores Obsidian's default light-mode backgrounds while tinting the sidebar and context menus with a subtle warm hue. Choose a Flexoki palette accent to override the accent color."
}
```
